name: python-html-sanitizer
title: HTML sanitizer that rebuilds instead of filtering
blurb: An allowlist HTML sanitizer whose output is written from parsed events, never copied from the input: script bodies dropped with their content, URL schemes checked after the browser's own whitespace stripping, attributes limited per tag, markup rebalanced, everything stable under a second pass, and an audit that reads the OUTPUT for dangerous constructs.
default_description: An allowlist HTML sanitizer that rebuilds markup and audits its own output.
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install -e . pytest ruff

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --quiet --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --quiet --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: the output is composed from allowed events only
